project: Qwen3.8 dynamic-context attention-aware Turbo4 KV paging
context_policy: For85-09 onward load repair85 packet/cluster and explicit context_files only; historical V10 overview, old testing and summaries are superseded, not loaded. New subsystem/context-based clusters reset stale sessions; no task-count cap.

runner.task_model_policy: V10 tasks49-54 have explicit risk-based Luna Medium/High recommendations and retry1_reasoning=high. Shared runner defaults unchanged. Native MTP acceptance is a mandatory evidence precondition before V10 speed claims.
runner.token_accounting: Persist every reported Codex turn.completed usage event per task and aggregate by phase and project; total is derived from input plus output when absent
runner.retry_sequence: V9 initial task-recommended Luna Medium or Luna High; retry1 same-family Luna High with artifact-aware prefix (per-task opt-in); before retry2 Luna High assessment then the original task model/reasoning; before retry3 Terra High assessment then the original task model/reasoning; then block. Explicit CLI reasoning override wins.
runner.retry_assessment: no separate assessment before retry1; same task model family/high before substantive retry2; next-tier/high from model_escalation_map before substantive retry3
runner.model_escalation_map: luna->terra, terra->sol, sol->sol (assessment-only; task model remains the original recommendation)
runner.block_escalation: Assessment-only escalation on retry3 using model_escalation_map; task model remains the original recommendation
runner.retry1_prompt: This is a retry, so assess the first attempt's output, and approach it accordingly.
runner.retry_assessment_prompt: Assess the task {task_id} and its output that is causing a retry to be needed. Fix the approach so it will achieve the task's goal, while staying aligned to the overall goals. Add and shift any tasks, if needed.
runner.retry_prompt_artifacts: .wiretail/build previous-attempt final/jsonl/stderr paths are injected when known; otherwise the runner directory and handoff are named
runner.benchmark_restore_policy: restore only for explicit control/revert benchmark, teardown, failed-start recovery, or final cleanup; never restore between successful dependent tasks

completion_contract.active_scope: repair85 tasks85-09 through85-19, route-policy task92-01, then bounded MTP diagnosis tasks93-01 through93-05; prior done records do not certify current capabilities
completion_contract.native_mtp_context: equals resolved target per-sequence logical context L
completion_contract.native_mtp_residency: Turbo4 K/V entirely GPU-resident; never a target pager victim
completion_contract.target_cold_backing: canonical opaque Turbo4 K/V in CPU RAM; initial tail host-ready only after D2H completion
completion_contract.target_hot_capacity: dynamic H after full-L draft, weights, recurrent state, A workspace, scratch, GPU catalogue and reserve; no fixed70K/77K production constant
completion_contract.attention_path: Corrected paged Turbo4 fused GPU attention or eligible mature contiguous view; reference is oracle, no mandatory native-MTP fallback, CPU attention or full-L F16 staging
completion_contract.cold_proof: production GPU selector -> immutable submission -> completed H2D -> publication -> completed target consumption; controlled and organic claims separate
completion_contract.benchmark_identity: immutable build-time executable/DSO source receipt, observed endpoint process hashes, actual token geometry and exact paired original3prompt controls
completion_contract.speed_policy: Small invariant-specific CUDA tests first; original3prompts plus actual C>H small matched speed at phase end; timings are findings, setup failures repaired/retested within task
completion_contract.scale_policy: Conditional32K/128K pilots then262144 capacity and honest occupancy, measured scratch before H; no per-edit context curve or indefinite slow loop
completion_contract.task_completion: named required implementation tests and hashed raw receipt; no deferred CUDA/live substitution; benchmark failed findings stay explicitly failed
completion_contract.final_review: only current summary; actual ordered repair/benchmark/summary/review successors if goal unmet; no evidence-only retry loop
completion_contract.code_portability: dynamic model/device/memory geometry; server-specific material only in /srv/ai or .wiretail, separate metadata commits; no upstream publication

external_gates.reason: A human must decide where the Buun-specific feature discussion belongs and write any GitHub-facing text.
external_gates.resolution: The user explicitly authorized iterative work and commits in vanwho/* forks. Upstream issues/PRs remain deferred until maintainer direction and repository rules are rechecked.
